## Overview
OpenAI is a private AI research and product company focused on frontier models, ChatGPT, enterprise AI, developer APIs, and model infrastructure partnerships. As a private company, it does not publish standard quarterly earnings, so this demo profile uses vendor intelligence indicators rather than public EPS data.

## Key Takeaways
- Enterprise adoption is centered on ChatGPT Enterprise, API usage, and custom model workflows
- Compute capacity, model safety, and platform reliability are central negotiation themes
- Microsoft Azure remains a major infrastructure and distribution partner
- Pricing varies across ChatGPT seats, API consumption, and enterprise commitments

## Highlights
- Strong demand for generative AI assistants across knowledge work and developer workflows
- Procurement focus should be on data retention, model governance, usage caps, and support SLAs
- Customers should evaluate model roadmap transparency and migration options across model tiers

## Investment Focus Areas
- **Products**: ChatGPT Enterprise, API platform, assistants, multimodal models
- **AI & Cloud**: Frontier model training, inference optimization, Azure infrastructure
- **Strategic Priorities**: Enterprise trust, safety, lower-latency inference, and broader workflow integration
